pathway_size_definition: Number of pathway genes overlapping the effective background universe, after filtering to the configured size range.
multiple_testing_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg separately for each cluster and library
background_definition: Unique mapped gene symbols from probes tested in Phase 6; ambiguous mappings and AFFX controls excluded. For each library, the effective background is further restricted to genes present in at least one gene set in that library.
